test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. It was as simple as announcing what you have in your store or the services you offer in your premises.

B. Over the years, advertising has evolved into a major industry that goes beyond informing to persuading and influencing.

C. Advertising was initially meant to make people aware of the goods available in the market.

D. It is a form of brainwashing consumers.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph begins by explaining the initial purpose of advertising.
 
• **Sentence C is the first sentence** as it sets the context of the evolution of advertising:
 
 
• "Advertising was initially meant to make people aware of the goods available in the market."
 
 
 
• **Sentence A follows** as it elaborates on the initial simplicity of advertising:
 
 
• "It was as simple as announcing what you have in your store or the services you offer in your premises."
 
 
 
• **Sentence B is the third sentence** because it shows how advertising has evolved over the years:
 
 
• "Over the years, advertising has evolved into a major industry that goes beyond informing to persuading and influencing."
 
 
 
• **Sentence D is the fourth** as it concludes by describing the impact of modern advertising:
 
 
• "It is a form of brainwashing consumers."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **CABD**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Advertising was initially meant to make people aware of the goods available in the market. It was as simple as announcing what you have in your store or the services you offer in your premises. Over the years, advertising has evolved into a major industry that goes beyond informing to persuading and influencing. It is a form of brainwashing consumers."
